response.goal: Get each new email in our Partners Gmail label summarized by an AI model and added to Airtable with sender, company, request type, a 2-sentence summary and a priority flag, with low confidence items reviewed by a person.

plan.step: Read new emails from the Partners Gmail label using the Gmail API
Summarize and extract sender, company, request type, 2-sentence summary and priority flag using an AI model
Add the parsed lead data into Airtable and route low-confidence items for human review

milestones.name: Milestone 1
milestones.deliverable: Gmail and Airtable integration script with AI extraction

proof_map.step: Read new emails from the Partners Gmail label using the Gmail API
Summarize and extract sender, company, request type, 2-sentence summary and priority flag using an AI model
Add the parsed lead data into Airtable and route low-confidence items for human review

risks.risk: Incorrect data extraction due to unstructured partnership emails
risks.mitigation: Include confidence scoring in the AI prompt to route low-confidence leads to manual review.

risks.risk: Hourly rate budget lacks a total project cap
risks.mitigation: Establish a weekly hour limit to control spending.

questions: What is the exact schema or table structure required in Airtable?
What criteria should define a low confidence priority flag?
assumptions: The client will provide access credentials for Gmail and Airtable.
Python will be used as the implementation language.
